risksForTheParent: The parent's main proof runs the authority-recovery group with BOTH keys set. U15a is NOT merged on this baseline (46de0b2f1 lives only on the U15a branch and is not an ancestor of 58fd434a4), so on this baseline the combat key reaches server.js and nothing reads it: COMBAT_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_MODE is still the literal 'off' at src/lib/multiplayer/server/matchJournalAuthority.ts:18. The forward is inert until U15a merges.

If U15a merges first, the same ladder run arms the combat journal-authority path for E2E-01/02 and the genesis clauses become provable. That is a behavior change in the proof, not in production: the arm requires NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MODE === 'true', which playwright.config.ts sets only for its own webServer.

Ordering: this unit can merge before or after U15a. Merging U15b first leaves an inert env key in the ladder plan; merging U15a first leaves a resolver nothing arms. Neither order breaks a gate, but the parent should not read a green authority-recovery run as genesis-clause evidence until BOTH are on main.

The `authority` and `all` expansions inherit the combat key because they include authority-recovery. A full `all` run therefore arms combat journal authority for every spec in the composite, not just E2E-01/02. That is the same blast radius the campaign key already has; it is inherited, not introduced here.

U15a is owner-gated on packet PK-u15a-ruling (authority review class). U15b's review class is routine only, so U15b does not itself need a Lane B ruling - but its usefulness is gated on that ruling landing.

The playwright.config.ts pin is a text pin, not a behavioral one. It proves the guard shape and both key names are present; it cannot prove Playwright actually spawns the server with the key. Only a real ladder run can, and this unit runs none.
